s.t:
Jasper is the leading AI marketing platform, enabling the world's most innovative companies to reimagine their end-to-end marketing workflows and drive higher ROI through increased brand consistency, efficiency, and personalization at scale.
Jasper has been recognized as "one of the Top 15 Most Innovative AI Companies of 2024" by Fast Company and is trusted by nearly 20% of the Fortune 500 – including Prudential, Ulta Beauty, and Wayfair. Founded in 2021, Jasper is a remote-first organization with team members across the US, France, and Australia.

As the Executive Assistant to the CEO , you will be a trusted strategic partner and force multiplier for our CEO, helping him operate at his highest level of impact. This role demands exceptional organizational skills, strong communication abilities, and the utmost discretion in handling confidential information.

Alongside this strategic remit, you'll also manage the CEO's schedule, travel, meeting materials, and other administrative essentials — with the same precision and attention to detail.

This role demands exceptional judgment, strong communication abilities across all levels of the organization, and the utmost discretion in handling confidential information.
This role reports to the Senior Manager, Executive Operations, and works in close daily partnership with the CEO. The role is open to candidates located in the UK, with a strong preference for someone based in London. While this is a fully remote role, there may be times when meeting the CEO and various partners in our London office is necessary, so flexibility to work out of this office is required.

s.h: What You Will Do At Jasper
s.t:
Manage the CEO’s schedule to arrange meetings, triage incoming requests, and ensure that all deadlines are met effectively.
Coordinate and facilitate communication between the executive and other internal team members, ensuring clear and effective collaboration.
Support the Executive Team working cadence including weekly meetings, regular brainstorming sessions and quarterly offsites.
Own travel arrangements and external engagement logistics with meticulous attention to detail, building contingency plans so nothing is left to chance.
Assist with key priorities including preparing necessary materials and organizing the CEO’s workflow.
Proactively identify issues and implement solutions to maintain momentum on critical activities.
Prepare materials and organize workflow to keep the CEO's key priorities moving forward.
Partner closely with the Senior Manager, Executive Operations and cross-functional leaders to strengthen and continuously improve executive operations processes.
Support the CEO's engagement with the Board and other senior stakeholders, including helping prepare materials and coordinate logistics for Board meetings and other high-stakes, elevated communications.
What You Will Bring To Jasper
7+ years of experience as an executive assistant or in a similar administrative role, ideally supporting C-level executives — with 2-4+ years directly supporting a CEO or Founder strongly preferred.
Exceptional organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with comfort communicating at the Board and executive level.
Sound independent judgment and decision-making — able to distinguish between what to run with and what to escalate.
Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with the highest level of discretion.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and autonomously.
Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build positive relationships with colleagues and external contacts.
Flexibility and adaptability in a fast-paced and dynamic work environment.

At Jasper, we believe in pay transparency and are committed to providing our employees and candidates with access to information about our compensation practices. The expected base salary range offered for this role is £85,000 - £100,000. Compensation may vary based on relevant experience, skills, competencies, and certifications.

Comprehensive Private Medical Insurance and Dental coverage
Workplace Pension with a 3% employer contribution
Equity grant participation
Flexible PTO with a FlexExperience budget ($900 annually) to help you make the most of your time away from work
FlexWellness program ($1,800 annually) to help support your personal health goals
Life Assurance and Income Protection Insurance
Generous budget for home office setup
$1,500 annual learning and development stipend
16 weeks of paid parental leave

The Administrative Assistant to the Marshal/Events Services Coordinator is a principal support services specialist for the Marshal's Office in the Supreme Court of the United States.

The incumbent has principal responsibility for event management, provides administrative support for oral argument sessions and a variety of other support activities and programs.

Works directly with high-level officials, outside vendors and contractors; responsible for researching, designing, planning, coordinating, and evaluating all events and programs under the direction of the Staff Assistant/Event Services Manager.

Must be present for all assigned events (approximately 900 yearly) that occur in the Supreme Court, including after-hour events (approximately 50 yearly).

Constantly faced with changing workloads, short deadlines and unanticipated requirements; logistical planning factors include room setup, rental equipment, audiovisual support, security, media, florists, transportation, entertainment, décor, and effectively integrating internal support staff and outside vendors.

Assists with menu selections, initiates requests for proposals and negotiates catering contracts; assigns the duties of the Supreme Court Police, Building Support Services, Architect of the Capitol staff, and Purveyor staff in connection with each event and maintains financial records.

Acts as the official Courtroom Timekeeper during oral argument; operates Teleconference Bridge for remote participants; works with IT to troubleshoot equipment.

Responsible for receiving visitors, responding to and following through on telephone calls and emails, preparing and distributing correspondence and responsible for completing various assigned projects in a timely manner. Performs other duties as assigned by the Marshal.
Five years of experience with event management and support services procedures are required.

A working knowledge of the Marshal's Office and the various offices of the Supreme Court, the Federal Judiciary and the Federal Government is desired; skill in gathering data and applying sound analyses; superior communications skills, both oral and written; sound judgment, tact, a very courteous demeanor and the ability to interact effectively with high-ranking officials and the general public are required; initiative and the ability to work independently within a team environment are also required.

As an ADMINISTRATIVE ASSISTANT, GS-0303-7, you will: Maintains the appointment schedule for the HRO and the DHRO. Schedules appointments and meetings, independently, based upon personal knowledge of their workload and current issues of importance.

Advises the HRO and the DHRO of scheduled appointments and furnishes information from files or schedules briefings by others in preparation for scheduled meetings. Reschedules appointments when it is apparent that they cannot meet previous schedules. Attends meetings when required to maintain notes. Prepares required slides for meetings.

Receives visitors and telephone calls for the HRO. Assists in the development of policy letters. Coordinates draft policy with other staff directorates prior to submission for final review and approval.

Maintains personal contact with HRO employees, functional managers (Army and Air), NGB personnel, and State personnel to discuss administrative requirements and services. Provides technical advice and guidance and recommends methods and procedures where necessary.

Advises other administrative personnel of latest HRO directives regarding administrative procedures. Reviews incoming correspondence, publications, regulations, and directives.

Prepares and/or reviews outgoing correspondence from the office of the HRO or subordinate branches for grammar, construction, proper format, attachments, continuity of text, policy and procedural adherence, and compliance with the HRO viewpoint. Advises the originator of any discrepancies and provides necessary training.

Maintains office files of correspondence, directives, regulations, and other information. Maintains security of all keys and maintains appropriate records of keys issued to personnel. Performs duties as HRO Publications Officer.

Coordinates with both Army and Air Force publications sources to accomplish ordering, locating electronic publications, updating, and maintaining a current and complete publications library for the HRO. Submits work orders for repairs and maintenance on HRO office equipment and facilities. Performs other duties as assigned.
General Experience: Administrative or clerical experience, education, or training which demonstrates the candidate's ability to perform the duties of the position. Experience using computer and automation systems. Specialized Experience: Must have at least 12 months experience in the interpretation and application of regulations, procedures or laws.

Experience that provided a working knowledge of administrative functions. Experience demonstrating the ability to advise lower graded employees. Experience working independently and setting priorities with very little supervisory control.

We are looking for a proactive, organized, and efficient self-starter to join our team in the role of Executive Assistant. As an Executive Assistant at the company, you will have the unique opportunity to work closely with our Executive Team. From managing daily schedules to crea…

The executive assistant is expected, on a routine basis, to be able to: perform a variety of confidential and complex administrative assignments on behalf of the executive director including: scheduling appointments as needed, including recurring meetings such as staff meetings, briefings for external parties in advance of Commission meetings, and recurring annual events; preparing and briefing the executive director on confidential matters to be considered before scheduled meetings, keeping executive director advised on time, place and topics to be discussed; making all necessary travel arrangements for the executive director, including scheduling visits, making hotel and travel reservations, maintaining contact with executive director while en route, writing necessary correspondence upon return; preparing and submitting travel reimbursement vouchers in accordance with Federal Travel Regulations (FTR) and internal travel policies; reviewing incoming correspondence for the executive director, including requests for meetings, screening out items that can be handled personally or forwarded to other appropriate staff for action; providing support with other tasks as assigned, particularly those that are of a confidential, sensitive, or high-priority nature; provide support for the Commission meetings, including: securing and independently managing operational contracts supporting on-site meeting support, to include researching, negotiating, and managing contracts and invoices, for meeting venues, hotels, MACPAC's travel agent, transcription services, and other necessary contractual support; managing travel purchase requests, reimbursement vouchers, and lodging reservations for travelers, ensuring that hotel has accurate guest list and dates of reservations; assessing other meeting needs such as security, parking, and supplies; assembling materials to distribute to Commissioners in advance of the meeting; working with other staff to ensure that appropriate materials are posted to the website, available for projection and meeting attendees; working with other operations staff and vendors to ensure that all meeting needs are addressed; and providing onsite logistical support; provide support to Commissioners by: scheduling meetings with Chair, Vice Chair, conflict of interest committee; etc.; addressing needs regarding accessibility of meeting materials, including reformatting as needed; communicating promptly and proactively before and after travel to coordinate travel arrangements; preparing and submitting travel purchase requests and reimbursement vouchers and relevant documentation in accordance with the FTR and internal travel policies; reviewing and approving travel reservations reserved through MACPAC's travel agency, including monitoring ticketing and adherence to the FTR; maintaining internal records related to contact information, addresses, assistants and their contact information; and preparing materials for orientation, including annual coordination of the Commissioner Handbook; maintain organizational files for archival purposes, including meeting materials, publications, and official correspondence, coordinating with leadership regarding compliance with National Archives and Records Administration requirements; assist communications team with maintenance of the email distribution list and daily clips that reference MACPAC and its work; and perform other duties as assigned, demonstrating commitment to team and personal success.
In order to perform the major duties listed above, the executive assistant must have: excellent organizational skills; demonstrated attention to detail and accuracy; ability to take initiative, work independently, assess priorities, meet deadlines, and manage multiple activities efficiently; ability to quickly adjust plans, schedules, and agendas to meet rapidly changing needs and priorities; knowledge of software applications, particularly Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Adobe Suite, and Constant Contact; excellent oral and written communication skills; an orientation toward problem solving, teamwork, and accountability; and willingness to engage in learning and development.

Introductory statement: This position is assigned to the Force Support Squadron (FSS) Resource Management Office and reports directly to the Resource Management Flight Chief.

The primary purpose of this position is to manage the Nonappropriated Fund (NAF) Accounting Office for the Buckley Morale, Welfare, and Recreation (MWR), Lodging Funds, and assigned Geographically Separated Unit (GSU) MWR Funds.

Duties and Responsibilities: Serves as the subject matter expert (SME) with independent responsibility for all accounting aspects of the Buckley MWR, Lodging, and assigned GSU MWR Funds, ensuring the overall integrity, accuracy, and propriety of the NAF accounting system, including all financial records, reports, and statements.

Provides comprehensive technical and administrative supervision over subordinate staff, including accounting technicians, clerks, and cashiers-by planning, organizing, directing, and evaluating program activities, determining work distribution, setting and adjusting priorities, and conducting informal training and cross-training to build back-up capabilities.

Executes a full range of supervisory personnel management duties, to include the selection, promotion, reassignment, and discipline of personnel, while establishing clear work requirements, timelines, and expected results both verbally and in writing.

Supervises staff performance across a full range of accounting duties using double-entry accrual methods for income and expense reporting, accounts receivable, accounts payable, payroll, inventory, and general ledger operations.

Monitors and approves financial transactions, operating statements, and subsidiary account tracking prepared by subordinates, and utilizes experienced judgment and research to resolve complex, non-standard transactions and out-of-balance conditions.

Oversees the Cash Management Investment Program (CMIP) to ensure deposits and distributions are balanced daily, enforces strict internal controls and separation of duties for overall funds integrity, and ensures management is kept aware of unusual financial variances or program changes.

Communicates directly with higher headquarters regarding accounting procedures and banking transactions, participates in financial management meetings with key stakeholders, and maintains the Life of the Fund file for each assigned fund.

Additionally, approves routine requests for Unit Funds and Special Morale & Welfare (SM&W) Funds, acts as the alternate Installation Program Coordinator for the NAF Purchase Card Program, maintains a contract warrant to serve as the alternate NAF Contracting Officer, and performs other related duties as assigned.

PERFORMANCE STANDARDS Performs all assigned duties in an accurate and timely manner, working independently to establish a work schedule based on operational requirements and deadlines. Responds to and communicates with both internal and external customers promptly and courteously.

Accurately maintains and updates all files to enable quick, efficient retrieval of information and ensure strict compliance with established directives. Ensures the overall integrity and accountability of systems maintained, actively guarding against system compromise.

Conducts effective problem-solving regarding the assigned mission with minimal supervision and ensures that all accounts and subsidiary ledgers in the assigned area are properly maintained and reconciled to produce accurate financial statements by established due dates.

Job Summary: The Office Administrator and Accounting Specialist is responsible for general office duties including supporting the financial operations of the organization by performing a range of accounting duties related to accounts receivable, accounts payable, and general ledger functions.

This role ensures accurate financial records, timely processing of transactions, and adherence to internal controls and compliance standards. Match purchase orders and receipts to invoices and investigate discrepancies. Prepare and process payments via check, ACH, or wire transfer. Maintain vendor records and respond to vendor inquiries. Assist with month-end closing and accruals related to AP.

Accounts Receivable Functions: Generate and distribute customer invoices in a timely and accurate manner. Apply customer payments to the appropriate accounts and follow up on outstanding receivables. Monitor aging reports and perform collection activities as needed. Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies or customer concerns.

Assist with revenue recognition and related reporting. General Duties: Reconcile account balances and support general ledger entries. Maintain accurate and organized financial documentation. Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., procurement, sales, operations) to resolve accounting issues.

You’ll manage executive calendars, communications, travel, strategic projects, and cross-functional coordination while serving as a trusted extension of leadership. Success in this role requires exceptional organization, sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to anticipate needs before they arise.

If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy supporting senior executives, and take ownership of complex priorities, this role is a strong fit. Prioritize schedules while protecting executive focus time. Resolve scheduling conflicts proactively. Prepare meeting agendas, executive briefings, and supporting materials. Take meeting notes and distribute action items. Coordinate virtual and in-person meeting logistics. Administrative Management Maintain confidential records, contracts, and documentation.

Process expense reports, invoices, and budget tracking. Improve administrative systems and workflows. Maintain organized executive files and documentation. Support day-to-day executive office operations. What Success Looks Like Executive calendars run smoothly with minimal oversight. Leadership remains organized, informed, and focused.

Meetings, projects, and follow-ups stay on schedule. Travel and logistics are managed seamlessly. Confidential information is handled with professionalism. Administrative processes continue improving as the business grows. What Makes You a Strong Fit You anticipate executive needs before they arise. You thrive in high-trust environments.

You remain calm under pressure and manage competing priorities effectively. You communicate professionally with executives and stakeholders. You solve problems independently and proactively. You maintain exceptional attention to detail while moving quickly.

Experience supporting executives in: Startups Consulting Finance Legal Technology High-growth organizations Experience coordinating domestic and international travel. Experience preparing executive presentations and reports. Experience supporting board members and senior stakeholders.

Inbox and communication responsiveness. On-time completion of executive projects and follow-ups. Travel planning accuracy and efficiency. Executive satisfaction and stakeholder feedback. Administrative process improvements. Accuracy of documentation and reporting. Why This Role Stands Out Direct partnership with executive leadership.

High ownership and visibility across the business. Opportunity to influence operations and executive effectiveness. Exposure to strategic planning, cross-functional initiatives, and decision-making. Fully remote role with long-term growth opportunities.

The Executive Assistant will play a critical role in transforming a high-volume inbox and meeting-heavy calendar into a streamlined, priority-driven workflow. Success in this role requires strong judgment, proactive communication, and the ability to create order from complexity. This role goes beyond traditional administrative support.

You will own core operational processes, manage communication systems, coordinate recruiting pipelines, and help implement tools and SOPs that reduce cognitive load for the CEO and leadership team.

This is a full-time, remote position requiring exceptional written communication, strong follow-through, comfort with sensitive information, and the ability to proactively manage both professional and limited personal tasks.

Location: Fully Remote Job Type: Full-Time Salary: $800 - $1,600 per month (based on experience) Requirements 3+ years of experience supporting senior executives as an EA, Operations Coordinator, or similar role.

Exceptional email management and prioritization skills Strong systems thinker with experience building organized workflows Proficient in digital tools (Notion strongly preferred) Highly proactive and detail-oriented Strong written communication skills Comfortable making judgment calls on prioritization Tech-comfortable and adaptable to evolving systems and tools.

Thrives in high-accountability, high-clarity environments. Technical Requirements: Reliable high-speed internet and a modern home office setup.

Treat discretion as a reflex: names, transactions, and conversations remain confidential, always.

## Description ##
### **Your Purpose** ###
As Assistant Boutique Manager, you will support the Boutique Manager in ensuring the smooth daily operation of the onboard boutiques while delivering an exceptional shopping experience to our guests.

You will contribute to maintaining high retail standards, supporting team coordination, and creating a professional and welcoming environment aligned with MSC Cruises- luxury hospitality values.

This role is key in supporting operational consistency, assisting new team members during onboarding, and strengthening collaboration across departments onboard.

You will play an important role in driving guest satisfaction and supporting the achievement of retail sales targets through excellent customer service, strong operational support, and effective team collaboration.

By assisting with merchandising, stock organization, and daily retail activities, you will help ensure that onboard boutiques operate efficiently and consistently across the fleet. Your contribution will support stronger team management, clearer role alignment, and a premium retail experience for guests sailing with MSC Cruises.
### **Your Journey So Far** ###

s.h: To succeed in this role, you-ll need
s.t:
· High school graduate or equivalent qualification
· Minimum 3 years- experience as Assistant Boutique Manager onboard a cruise ship, or similar role
· Successful completion of MSC Shops- internal promotion plan from Shop Seller is considered an advantage
· Proven experience in retail operations and customer service
· Experience working in multicultural and fast-paced environments
· Previous cruise ship experience preferred
### **Your Essentials** ###

s.h: To succeed in this role, you-ll need
s.t:
· Fluent spoken and written English (minimum B1 level required)
· Additional European languages are considered an advantage depending on itinerary
· Strong communication and interpersonal skills
· Team-oriented mindset with leadership potential
· Organized, proactive, and guest-focused attitude
· Ability to work onboard for extended periods in an international environment
· Professional appearance and strong customer service approach
· Flexibility and adaptability to dynamic operational needs onboard
Are you ready to set sail on an extraordinary career journey? As part of our dynamic onboard retail team, you-ll help create unforgettable shopping experiences for our guests. If you-re passionate about customer service, have a flair for leadership, and thrive in a vibrant, multicultural environment, we-d love to welcome you aboard.
## Our commitment ##
We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.
Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Office Manager/in 100%
======================
**Ihre Aufgaben**
* Organisation und Koordination des administrativen Tagesgeschäfts sowie zentrale Anlaufstelle für interne organisatorische Anliegen
* Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Informationsflusses zwischen Geschäftsleitung, Administration, Verkauf, Shops und weiteren internen Stellen
* Koordination von Telefonzentrale, Postwesen sowie ein\- und ausgehenden Sendungen
* Bearbeitung von Lager\- und Betriebsbestellungen sowie Koordination des Einkaufs
* Überwachung von Verbrauchs\- und Verpackungsmaterialien inklusive rechtzeitiger Nachbestellungen
* Erfassung von Wareneingängen sowie Pflege von Artikel\-, Kunden\-, Lieferanten\- und weiteren Stammdaten
* Schriftliche und telefonische Korrespondenz mit Kunden, Lieferanten und Geschäftspartnern
* Pflege der Kunden\- und Geschäftspartnerdaten im CRM
* Koordination und Nachverfolgung administrativer Aufgaben
* Unterstützung bei internen Projekten und Abläufen sowie aktive Mitarbeit bei der Optimierung administrativer Prozesse
* Übernahme und Koordination wichtiger Aufgaben bei Abwesenheiten
**Ihr Profil**
* Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung (z.B. Kauffrau/Kaufmann EFZ)
* Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einer vielseitigen administrativen oder organisatorischen Funktion
* Sehr gute Kenntnisse in MS Office
* Selbständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise
* Ausgeprägte Organisationstalent und Freude daran, viele unterschiedliche Themen gleichzeitig im Blick zu behalten
* Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Diskretion, und Teamfähigkeit
* Sehr gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
**Was diese Position besonders macht**
Diese Position ist eine wichtige organisatorische Schaltstelle innerhalb der Lohri AG. Bei Dir laufen viele Informationen und Aufgaben zusammen. Du sorgst dafür, dass Themen aufgenommen, richtig eingeordnet, weitergeleitet und konsequent nachverfolgt werden.
Dabei geht es ausdrücklich nicht darum, sämtliche Aufgaben allein auszuführen. Einzelne Tätigkeiten können von verschiedenen Mitarbeitenden übernommen werden. Als Office Manager/in stellst Du jedoch sicher, dass die Abläufe organisiert sind, Verantwortlichkeiten klar sind und nichts vergessen geht.
Du kennst die wichtigsten Abläufe unseres Betriebs, weisst, wer für welches Thema zuständig ist, und bist für viele organisatorische Fragen die erste Anlaufstelle.
**Das erwartet Dich bei uns**
Bei der Lohri AG erwartet Dich eine abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit in einem vielseitigen Betrieb. Die kurzen Entscheidungswege ermöglichen Dir, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, eigene Ideen einzubringen und Abläufe aktiv mitzugestalten.
Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit, die gerne organisiert, mitdenkt und Verantwortung übernimmt – und die Freude daran hat, gemeinsam mit dem Team dafür zu sorgen, dass im Hintergrund alles funktioniert.
